  keyCards = '- **2022 Upper Deck FATWS Sam Wilson Captain America** — The new Cap reveal card, $10-30

- **2022 Upper Deck FATWS Anthony Mackie Auto** — New Captain America signed card, $80-200+',
  content = '## Passing the Shield

The Falcon and the Winter Soldier tackled something no Marvel property had before — what does it mean for a Black man to carry Captain America''s shield in a country with America''s history? Anthony Mackie''s Sam Wilson grappled with this question honestly, making his eventual acceptance of the mantle feel earned rather than inevitable.

## Zemo''s Renaissance

Daniel Bruhl''s Baron Zemo went from Civil War''s quiet antagonist to a fan-favorite anti-hero. His dancing scene in Madripoor became an instant meme, and his philosophical debates about super-soldiers added intellectual weight to the action. Zemo proved that Marvel''s best villains are the ones who might have a point.

## Isaiah Bradley: Marvel''s Most Important Story

The introduction of Isaiah Bradley — a Black super-soldier experimented on and erased from history — was the show''s most powerful storyline. Carl Lumbly''s performance was devastating, and the storyline connected Marvel fiction to real American history in a way that resonated deeply.

## Fun Facts

- The show was originally planned as a buddy comedy before being reworked to address race
- Daniel Bruhl''s Zemo dance was improvised and almost cut before becoming viral
- Julia Louis-Dreyfus''s Valentina was originally meant to debut in Black Widow
- The Flag Smashers storyline was rewritten during COVID to remove a pandemic subplot
- Anthony Mackie''s new Captain America suit was designed by Ryan Meinerding',
  metaDescription = 'The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (2021) guide — new Captain America, Baron Zemo, Isaiah Bradley, trading card values, and the legacy of the shield.',

He''s more anti-hero than outright villain here."}]',
